articles.deck: Friends remember Sadie Demetriou for the many years of service to Stonebridge.
body: Born in Stonebridge in the years after the war, Sadie Demetriou spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood.

articles.title: Hickory Ridge Residents Push for Basketball Court
articles.deck: Residents of Hickory Ridge met on Sunday to talk over the plan.
body: The effort began in November when a handful of neighbors met at the Hickory Ridge rec center to talk about basketball court. Organizers say the work is on schedule and that volunteers are still needed on Sunday mornings.

The Hickory Ridge Improvement Group will post updates on its bulletin board outside the library. Sadie Quinlan, who has lived on Rail Court for 39 years, said the response has been better than anyone expected.
The group has raised $12,000 so far and is asking for help with supplies and food. Anyone interested can attend the next planning meeting at the Hickory Ridge rec center on Sunday at 7 p.m.
